verses.original: רוּחִ֣י חֻ֭בָּלָה יָמַ֥י נִזְעָ֗כוּ קְבָרִ֥ים לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: rū·ḥî ḥub·bā·lāh yā·may niz·‘ā·ḵū qə·ḇā·rîm lî
verses.literal: My spirit is broken my days are extinguished the grave awaits me

verses.original: אִם־ לֹ֣א הֲ֭תֻלִים עִמָּדִ֑י עֵינִֽי׃ תָּלַ֥ן וּ֝בְהַמְּרוֹתָ֗ם
verses.literal: Surely . . . mockers surround me and my eyes must gaze at their rebellion

verses.original: שִֽׂימָה־ נָּ֭א עָרְבֵ֣נִי עִמָּ֑ךְ מִֽי ה֝֗וּא לְיָדִ֥י יִתָּקֵֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: śî·māh- nā ‘ā·rə·ḇê·nî ‘im·māḵ mî hū lə·yā·ḏî yit·tā·qê·a‘
verses.literal: Give [me] I pray the pledge You [demand] Who else . . . will be my guarantor . . .

verses.original: כִּֽי־ צָפַ֣נְתָּ לִ֭בָּם מִּשָּׂ֑כֶל עַל־ כֵּ֝֗ן לֹ֣א תְרֹמֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṣā·p̄an·tā lib·bām miś·śā·ḵel ‘al- kên lō ṯə·rō·mêm
verses.literal: - You have closed their minds to understanding therefore . . . You will not exalt them

verses.original: יַגִּ֣יד רֵעִ֑ים לְ֭חֵלֶק וְעֵינֵ֖י בָנָ֣יו תִּכְלֶֽנָה׃
verses.transliteration: yag·gîḏ rê·‘îm lə·ḥê·leq wə·‘ê·nê ḇā·nāw tiḵ·le·nāh
verses.literal: If a man denounces his friends for a price the eyes of his children will fail

verses.original: וְֽ֭הִצִּגַנִי לִמְשֹׁ֣ל עַמִּ֑ים אֶֽהְיֶֽה׃ לְפָנִ֣ים וְתֹ֖פֶת
verses.literal: He has made me a byword among the people [a man] in whose face they spit

verses.original: עֵינִ֑י וַתֵּ֣כַהּ מִכַּ֣עַשׂ כֻּלָּֽם׃ וִֽיצֻרַ֖י כַּצֵּ֣ל
verses.literal: My eyes have grown dim with grief and my whole body is but a shadow

verses.original: יְשָׁרִ֣ים יָשֹׁ֣מּוּ עַל־ זֹ֑את וְ֝נָקִ֗י יִתְעֹרָֽר׃ עַל־ חָנֵ֥ף
verses.transliteration: yə·šā·rîm yā·šōm·mū ‘al- zōṯ wə·nā·qî yiṯ·‘ō·rār ‘al- ḥā·nêp̄
verses.literal: The upright are appalled at this and the innocent are stirred against the godless

verses.original: צַדִּ֣יק וְיֹאחֵ֣ז דַּרְכּ֑וֹ יָ֝דַ֗יִם וּֽטֳהָר־ יֹסִ֥יף אֹֽמֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ṣad·dîq wə·yō·ḥêz dar·kōw yā·ḏa·yim ū·ṭo·hār- yō·sîp̄ ’ō·meṣ
verses.literal: Yet a righteous one holds to his way and the one with clean hands . . . grows stronger

verses.original: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם וּבֹ֣אוּ נָ֑א תָּ֭שֻׁבוּ כֻּלָּ֣ם וְלֹֽא־ אֶמְצָ֖א חָכָֽם׃ בָכֶ֣ם
verses.transliteration: wə·’ū·lām ū·ḇō·’ū nā tā·šu·ḇū kul·lām wə·lō- ’em·ṣā ḥā·ḵām ḇā·ḵem
verses.literal: But come back . . . and try again all of you For I will not find a wise man among you

verses.original: יָמַ֣י עָ֭בְרוּ זִמֹּתַ֣י נִתְּק֑וּ מ֖וֹרָשֵׁ֣י לְבָבִֽי׃
verses.literal: My days have passed my plans are broken off even the desires of my heart

verses.original: יָשִׂ֑ימוּ לַ֭יְלָה לְי֣וֹם א֝֗וֹר קָר֥וֹב מִפְּנֵי־ חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.transliteration: yā·śî·mū lay·lāh lə·yō·wm ’ō·wr qā·rō·wḇ mip·pə·nê- ḥō·šeḵ
verses.literal: They have turned night into day [making] light seem near in the face of darkness

verses.original: אִם־ אֲ֭קַוֶּה שְׁא֣וֹל בֵּיתִ֑י רִפַּ֥דְתִּי יְצוּעָֽי׃ בַּ֝חֹ֗שֶׁךְ
verses.literal: If I look for Sheol as my home if I spread out my bed in darkness

verses.original: קָ֭רָאתִי לַשַּׁ֣חַת אָ֑תָּה אָ֣בִי לָֽרִמָּֽה׃ אִמִּ֥י וַ֝אֲחֹתִ֗י
verses.literal: and say to corruption You [are] my father and to the worm My mother or ‘My sister

verses.original: וְ֭אַיֵּה אֵפ֣וֹ תִקְוָתִ֑י מִ֣י יְשׁוּרֶֽנָּה׃ וְ֝תִקְוָתִ֗י
verses.literal: where then is my hope Who can see any hope for me

verses.original: תֵּרַ֑דְנָה בַּדֵּ֣י שְׁאֹ֣ל אִם־ נָֽחַת׃ס יַ֖חַד עַל־ עָפָ֣ר
verses.literal: Will it go down to the gates of Sheol - Will we go down together into the dust
